about: One example NDJSON frame per message type in each direction, in full form (every optional field present); `optional` names, per type, the fields a frame may leave out. This is the one place the protocol is written down that both sides test against (issue #97): sidecar/src/protocol.test.ts holds the Inbound/Outbound types to these frames, and App/Tests/AdvisorTests/ProtocolContractTests.swift holds SidecarManager's sends and its inbound handling to them. Change this file with the protocol. Types: sidecar/src/protocol.ts; prose: DESIGN.md, IPC contract.
